episode_summary: A leak-plagued Friday broadcast opens with studio gremlins and a JD Vance avatar that mutates into a Hitler-werewolf before being ejected. Case covers the Young Republicans' leaked Hitler-praising chat, then oversees a Pop-Tart vs strudel debate derailed by Crum's wool-pants confession and Munch's claimed mind-control wavelength. JumpStart mascot Frankie admits arson and a racist podcast with Oscar the Grouch. The second news block spans Santos's commutation, ICE patrols, WWE's AI storytelling hire, and B-52s drawing a sky-penis over Venezuela. The show closes with DJ C4 orchestrating a dual diss track between theme-park rivals Rob Alvey and Robbie Love, ending in a ban-happy R&B freestyle.
